news_items.headline: Why Astera Labs Stock Is Roaring Higher This Week

news_items.summary: Coverage of momentum driven by RBC's $250 PT and the AI infrastructure narrative around Amazon's Trainium3 ramp.

news_items.headline: ALAB Stock Climbs As RBC Hikes AI-Driven Price Target
news_items.summary: RBC's bullish thesis centers on Amazon-Anthropic expanded deal funneling demand to ALAB's Scorpio X switches for Trainium3 racks in H2 2026.

news_items.headline: Insider Sale: President and COO of $ALAB Sells 2,282 Shares

news_items.headline: Astera Labs gains as investors refocus on AI interconnect demand and upcoming earnings catalyst
news_items.summary: Investor focus returning to the AI interconnect demand thesis; Scorpio ramp cited as the key near-term driver.

news_items.headline: Does Astera Labs' Earnings Beat, AI Switch Launch And ESOP Shelf Change The Bull Case For ALAB?
news_items.summary: Q1 2026 beat plus launch of Scorpio X-Series 320-lane Smart Fabric Switch and expanded Scorpio P-Series PCIe-6 (32-320 lane configs); multi-customer shipments expected H2 2026.

analyst_consensus.recent_changes: Evercore ISI raised PT to $297 from $215 (2026-05-19). RBC raised PT to $250 from $225 with Outperform reiterated (2026-05-19). Consensus Buy / Moderate Buy across 19-26 analysts.

earnings_context.notes: Q1 2026 reported 2026-05-05: EPS $0.61 vs $0.49 consensus (beat by 24.49%); revenue +14% sequential / +93% YoY on AI data center demand. Street expects continued AI-driven ramp; Scorpio X switch ramp in Trainium3 racks (Q3) is the key near-term catalyst with multi-customer shipments H2 2026 and broader volume in 2027.
